_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: F&G ~50, flat funding, neutral CVD and mild 30d drift equal a coil; no vol/ETF breaker to leave Anxiety ±1.
next_move.brains_agree: No — analyst firm HOLD/Anxiety; narrative silent on forward phase (flow-only), so consensus defaults to higher-trust analyst
next_move.confirmed_if: F&G holds 45-55, BTC range-bound, no vol expansion, ETF flows still absent
next_move.invalidated_if: F&G under 40 with funding negative and downside acceleration, or sharp ETF rebound with F&G above 60
